analysis:
# Latency-sensitive range coalescing

Five alternating complete-player pairs under50ms media-response delay: median startup-plus-three-seek latency delta -5.8853%; predeclared median10%+allpairs-lower+30%maximumextra-server-read-media-byte gate failed. Actual Native remux player, authored36s H264/AAC TS,50ms server response delay for each media request only; no bandwidth cap. Network emulator is not actual WAN. Byte counters are server ReadStream bytes, including possible buffered/abandoned bytes; not exact client reception. Browser launch/common harness load excluded; all media responses delayed, module/runtime responses not delayed. Startup charges player creation. ChromeCPU excludes server/OS media services. Localhost cold browser contexts do not flush OS cache. Not physical first sound/photon. Prior local-only whole-player result remains a valid negative (startup+one-seek median+3.314%); this is a separately declared latency-sensitive workload, not removal of that result.

The profile was declared before execution because source definition explicitly predicts a latency-sensitive request-count benefit. Delay applies only to media responses. It is an emulated50ms response latency, not an actualWAN benchmark. The earlier baseline-only fast2x drain attempt produced8droppedframes out of241 and failed its quality gate; that attempt is retained. Before a fresh comparison, the workload was narrowed to normal1x playback and the identical frame-quality gate retained. There is no2x delayed-link qualification. Fixed3seek workload and0.2s targetprogression differ from priorlocalone-seek profile, so percentages must not be directly subtracted.
